description: List popular SkyAccess private jet routes, each with its origin, destination and minPrice: the lowest whole-aircraft empty leg price currently listed on the route, in USD (taxes and fees shown at checkout), or null when no flight on the route currently has a listed price. Results are stable, not a live ranking: the list is a curated catalogue, six featured routes first and then the routes travelers searched most over the last 30 days, served from a cache refreshed about every 30 minutes, so repeated calls return the same routes. Pass a route to search_empty_legs to see its flights.
name: list_routes
title: List popular private jet routes
